تستخلبوا (form X)
# تَسْتَخْلِبُوا (tastaḵlibū) /tas.tax.li.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَخْلَبَ (istaḵlaba)
# تُسْتَخْلَبُوا (tustaḵlabū) /tus.tax.la.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَخْلَبَ (istaḵlaba)
